items.markdown:
![What's the System Usability Scale (SUS) & How Can You Use It?](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/10081545-2633-0066-0000-2c298945171e:4)
You can calculate a System Usability Scale score using the [SUS Calculator](https://uiuxtrend.com/sus-calculator/) tool or by applying the standard 10-item formula.[[1]](https://stuart-cunningham.github.io/sus/)[[2]](https://uiuxtrend.com/sus-calculator/)

### How to Calculate a SUS Score

- **Step 1: Rate the 10 Items** — Users score 10 statements from 1 (Strongly disagree) to 5 (Strongly agree).[[1]](https://cleverx.com/blog/system-usability-scale-sus-complete-scoring-walkthrough/)[[2]](https://www.koji.so/docs/system-usability-scale-guide)
- **Step 2: Adjust Odd Items** — For odd-numbered questions (1, 3, 5, 7, 9), subtract 1 from the user score.[[1]](https://www.koji.so/docs/system-usability-scale-guide)
- **Step 3: Adjust Even Items** — For even-numbered questions (2, 4, 6, 8, 10), subtract the user score from 5.[[1]](https://www.koji.so/docs/system-usability-scale-guide)
- **Step 4: Sum the Values** — Add all 10 adjusted scores together to get a total between 0 and 40.[[1]](https://www.koji.so/docs/system-usability-scale-guide)
- **Step 5: Multiply by 2.5** — Multiply the total by 2.5 to convert the final score to a 0–100 scale.[[1]](https://www.koji.so/docs/system-usability-scale-guide)

### Score Interpretation

- **Average Score:** 68 (Scores above 68 are above average).
- **Grade A:** 80.3–100 (Excellent)
- **Grade B:** 68–79 (Good)
- **Grade C:** 51–67 (Okay)
- **Grade D:** 26–50 (Poor)
- **Grade F:** 0–25 (Awful)[[1]](https://uiuxtrend.com/sus-calculator/)[[2]](https://stuart-cunningham.github.io/sus/)[[3]](https://uiuxtrend.com/measuring-system-usability-scale-sus/)[[4]](https://cleverx.com/blog/system-usability-scale-sus-complete-scoring-walkthrough/)

If you have raw numbers from a test, share the **10 individual item ratings** and I can calculate the final SUS score for you.
